title: Algebraic Hodge Loci and Exceptional Correspondences

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India; Formerly, University of Calcutta (Heramba Chandra College), 23/49 Gariahat Road, Golpark, Kolkata 700029, West Bengal, India

description: We construct algebraic Hodge classes in explicit abelian and K3 families and reduce abelian transfer to primitive middle-degree classes on rational varieties. Exact correspondence formulas and bounded-support criteria isolate the generic mixed Mumford class. Its algebraicity and the universal Hodge conjecture remain open.
